limits: All search scoring delegated to pinned Orama library, not Elasticsearch/Lucene.
All 35 questions were established before this experiment; unseen denotes the six-question group introduced in the previous benchmark, not a new holdout.
Identical cached vectors feed vector/hybrid; BM25 calls no embedding API at query time.
In-memory Node timing excludes network latency and is not a load test.
Pre-authorized synthetic corpus only; no production authorization/sync integration is claimed.
No filters, reranker, graph, answer generation, field tuning or parameter tuning.
Orama BM25 variant/tokenization and hybrid normalization differ from PostgreSQL FTS/RRF; a result change cannot be attributed to BM25 alone.
